tasks.gr9-graphic-orthographic-drawing-t1: Topic: Graphic communication and orthographic drawing. Cover first-angle orthographic projection, front/top/side views, scale, line types (solid, dashed, construction), and dimension awareness. Ask Grade 9 learners to draw 2D views from 3D objects, interpret technical drawings accurately, apply correct line conventions, understand scale relationships, and use proper dimensions for manufacturing accuracy.
tasks.gr9-structures-accessible-design-t1: Topic: Structures and accessible design. Cover static and dynamic forces, bending, torsion, material properties, stairs, wheelchair ramps, and IDMEC (Inclusive Design) principles. Ask Grade 9 learners to develop a design brief, analyze forces in structures, build and evaluate scale models, apply accessibility criteria (ramp gradients, step dimensions), and justify material and design choices for safety and inclusivity.
